card.name: Linking words before a named treatment
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'with', 'of' and 'receive' that come right before a drug or treatment name in trial or reaction descriptions. Typical settings are 'compared with', 'treated with', 'co-administered with' and 'randomized to receive'.

modes.label: With after treated or compared
modes.description: The word 'with' after treated, compared or co-administered, just before the comparator or partner drug.
modes.example: in the KRYSTEXXA co-administered<< with>> methotrexate group compared to

modes.label: Of or receive before a drug
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'receive' that leads into a trial population or a named drug.
modes.example: were randomized to<< receive>> niacin extended-release tablets 15

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly odd words like plate, album and repository, so there is no clear link to the next word.
